scope: Integration diff b1eb5351...39a2841e (merge base equals target head; 86 files, +5575/-1251). The delta 8bddff05..39a2841e (11 files: W37 #1582 632b93981 and c1a7a6adb, W38 #1583 4e17daa14, W39 #1584 92ed689d2) read line by line against each finding of review-1555.json and review-1555-8bddff05.json: .github/workflows/verify-skills.yml; skills/scripts/check_skill_files.py (CLASSIC, API_BASE, Where, finding, held_aside, main) with skills/test/test_check_skill_files.py; work-planner sync.py (misrouted, belongs, epicless, task_titled, NAMED_SPAN, head_path, review_changes and the module docstring), board.py Outputs, closure.py, epic.md, epic-issue-body.md and sync-mode.md with their tests. AC27, AC48, AC49 hold by the checker over skills/*/ (0 findings). AC54 holds except for a single-branch unit whose task-branch slug ends in a long-lived branch name: see the open finding. A residual absolute-URL gap is recorded as a new finding. Still holds at 39a2841e: its tests pass and the code it rests on changed only where the 8bddff05 findings below were fixed.

A nested-skill exclusion defect in the new code is recorded as a new finding. Verified fixed: NAMED_FILE requires a letter-led extension; a dotted bare name is measured only when a file at the head carries its extension, and a <branch>:<path> component only for that branch's base; ReviewChanges dotted-name and component tests fail at ba685e7e and pass here. A prose/code mismatch on extensionless paths is recorded as a new finding. Still holds at 39a2841e: its tests pass and the code it rests on changed only where the 8bddff05 findings below were fixed.

epic.md said a span with a directory names a file while sync.py required an extension. Verified fixed: NAMED_SPAN strips #anchor and :line suffixes (sync.py:532), head_path (:543-556) measures a directory span with an extension or a top-level directory of the head, a path stands where the head holds a file or directory (sync.py:587-592), and epic.md:79, epic-issue-body.md:168 and the sync.py docstring state the same rule. Extensionless, directory and line-reference tests fail at 8bddff05 and pass here.

sync.py epicless missed malformed initiative titles. Verified fixed: epicless (sync.py:471-480) reports a title opening with [I<nn> (not followed by a digit) whose PREFIX names no epic; [I01:E1], [I01: E00] and [I01 E00] are reported, [I010 and [I02] are not (EpiclessTitles fails at 8bddff05).

Stale sync.py and board.py docstrings. Verified fixed: sync.py :41-43 states the task-titled retitle, the Epic paragraph states the span rule, :75-80 states the no-epic forms and the Target base; board.py Outputs (:201-205) names a merge into a task branch as unverified.

No CI ran pytest skills/test, and a tree with no skill made argparse exit 2. Verified fixed: verify-skills.yml job check-suite runs python -m pytest skills/test -q (both jobs succeeded at 39a2841e); roots is nargs='*' and test_a_tree_holding_no_skill_passes runs the real step over an empty tree.

skills/work-planner/scripts/sync.py:451-460 belongs() reads a task branch's last hyphenated word as the long-lived branch it belongs to before reading the target, but delivery-branches.md:173-180 reserves that word only for a unit changing several long-lived branches; a single-branch unit's slug comes from its Description and may end in a branch name. Probe with LONG_LIVED=(main, workspace): belongs('i01/e00/w04-tidy-workspace', 'i01/e00/w03-x') returns ('workspace',) and belongs('i01/e00/w04-document-main', 'main') returns ('main',). For a unit whose Component is main:src/..., a pull request from i01/e00/w04-tidy-workspace into a stacked branch is reported 'it targets i01/e00/workspace', a single base, so sync-mode.md:92-95 retargets it there without consulting the Component and the task merges into the wrong epic base. epic.md:87 states the same precedence. AC54's 'its Target finding names the base to retarget to' is false in that case. Fix: name the branch from the last slug word only when the work item's Component or the epic's bases confirm it, or have sync-mode always check the Component before retargeting.
